_comment: Currency requirements: minimum controlling hours to remain on a facility's roster. 'period' is 'quarter' (per calendar quarter) or 'half' (per calendar half-year). Set 'hours' for a single requirement, OR 'home'/'visitor' when they differ (each falls back to 'hours' if omitted). Keys are VATUSA facility codes. There is intentionally NO default — a facility not listed (or missing the relevant role's hours) shows as 'Unknown currency requirement'.
